title: Monday Meme From Scratch
tests: Tests turning a vague topic into one finished visual meme by choosing the imagery, joke, and readable text without unnecessary clarification.

judge.summary: A finished, clearly legible Monday meme pairs a sleeping cat and coffee mug with an effective entered-the-chat/left-the-chat joke.

must_haves.item: The deliverable is a finished meme image, not just a suggested caption or description.
must_haves.why: The output is a complete image with a photograph and integrated meme captions.

must_haves.item: The caption explicitly references Monday or Mondays.
must_haves.why: The top caption reads “MONDAY HAS ENTERED THE CHAT.”

must_haves.item: The image and caption together convey an identifiable joke about Mondays, rather than a plain motivational poster.
must_haves.why: “I HAVE LEFT THE CHAT” responds to Monday's arrival, with the sleeping cat conveying humorous disengagement.

must_haves.item: All caption text is legible, fully inside the image, and contrasts with its background.
must_haves.why: Both captions are fully visible in large white lettering with thick black outlines.

must_haves.item: The visual supports the caption's joke or reaction.
must_haves.why: The cat lying asleep beside a coffee mug reinforces the joke about being unwilling to face Monday.
